utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope the parking situation doesn't cause a mess — that lot is always a nightmare on weekends.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's a good point—I hadn't thought about parking. Have you heard if they're expecting a big crowd?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven't heard any numbers, but if Cleo's already stockpiling parts, it might draw more people than usual. We should ask if they've arranged extra parking.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Eli just told me it's this Saturday morning—sounds like a good chance to put my tools to use. I'll bring my wrenches and toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Wrenches are key. I’ll check my screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Leo! If we can round up a few more folks with drills and hammers, we'll have a solid crew.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're collecting old electronics at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — they'll fix just about anything, and I'm bringing my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! My old blender's been acting up, maybe I'll bring that too. Did you hear they're also looking for volunteers to help sort donations?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center, and I've been gathering spare parts all week.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that's good to know. I might have a broken radio somewhere, but I'm not sure it's worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Don't write it off just yet—bring it by and I'll see if I've got the right parts to get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo! I'm glad you're here — have you heard about the repair drive? I've got some old tools I'm planning to bring, and I think it'd be great if you could help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I saw something about that. Is it still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it's this weekend! I'm pretty sure about that. Could you let anyone else know? The more people we get, the better.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey, I keep hearing about this repair drive from different folks—sounds like it's really happening. Are you planning to join in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Rosa asked me to help out this Saturday. Sounds like a good thing for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's definitely this Saturday then? I was hoping to pitch in too—do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey, I've been asking around about a repair drive—sounds like some folks know something about it. You heard anything, Eli?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've heard a few bits here and there, but nothing concrete yet. I'm waiting to hear more details before I decide.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Well, if you do hear more, I'm ready to lend a hand—just let me know!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I heard from Rosa that the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center — just wanted to make sure you got the memo.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks Dane, I hadn't heard that. Let me confirm with the school and then I can update the parent list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Faye. Let me know if you need me to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you already know! Isn't it great? I was just about to spread the word to a few more folks down the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Mara mentioned the Hernandez family's screws and hinges—that's a solid contribution. Have you checked with the Davises yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I'm heading their way next! Want to come along and help me spread the news?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I've been out and about—what's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, that. I think Rosa's organizing it Saturday—something about tool collections? I've been spread thin, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've heard a bit about Rosa being involved—have they figured out where we're supposed to drop off tools yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, I'm so glad you're here! We've got screws and hinges from the Hernandez family, and Gus has tools ready—this repair drive is really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That's great progress. Do we have enough volunteers signed up to handle all the tasks?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We've got a solid core group, but a few more hands would make the work lighter—want to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, I'm pretty sure! Vik and Rey were just talking about it—Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4. Maybe the flyers are still up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I haven't seen any flyers. I'll believe it when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa! The repair drive is this weekend at the community center—they're taking old electronics to fix up for folks who can't afford repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's right, Tess! Though just a heads-up, we've actually moved it to Sunday now—same place, just a day later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa! Sunday works better for me anyway—I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, are you coming to the repair drive? Do you have any tools we can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, right, that thing Vik was telling me about. I've got an old toaster, but I don't know about tools—I might've misplaced my toolbox again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, if you find your toolbox, bring it along. And the toaster too—maybe someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: At least there's overflow parking behind the old bakery, so that's one less thing to stress about.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that's great. I'm just glad more folks are pitching in—I've got my tools ready to go for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, I hope everyone remembers to bring their own extension cords—I don't want a tangle of borrowed ones causing a tripping hazard.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, yes! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. I've been gathering spare parts for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll grab my toolbox and see you there—Mina just reminded me to get the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Ira! I've got a good stash of spare parts ready to go. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm really looking forward to the repair drive—I've got some old tools I can bring!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Jules! Every bit helps—Gus has tools ready too, and I'm checking with Quinn about spare parts. We're really coming together!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's wonderful! With everyone chipping in, this is going to be a huge success.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: So Noah, I've been asking around about this repair drive—have you heard anything definitive about it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, repair drive? Oh yeah, something about Rosa and Eli I think? Sorry, it's all a blur.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, Rosa and Eli? I talked to Rosa earlier, but she didn't mention anything specific. Maybe I should check with Eli next.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Opal, I heard from Rosa that the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Just wanted to pass that along in case you hadn't heard.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane, but I'm pretty sure it's still Saturday—I just saw Quinn spreading the word about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Huh, that's strange—Rosa seemed pretty certain when she told me. Maybe we should both double-check with someone else to clear it up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules mentioned a repair drive. Have you seen anyone you recognize running it, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think Rosa is organizing it. Eli's bringing his toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did you see Rosa there yourself, or did someone tell you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I'm not sure—I just figured it was still on this weekend. Did you hear otherwise?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm trying to pin that down myself. Let me check with Mara to see if we can get a firm date and a list of needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's good. Let me know when you hear back—I might be able to help if I'm free.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmm, I still haven't seen any official notice or heard from anyone else. Are you sure this repair drive is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Definitely! I heard it from Mrs. Chen at number 42, and I've already told a bunch of people. It's happening this Saturday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I still haven't seen any flyers or emails about it. Are you sure Mrs. Chen isn't mixing things up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, have you heard when this repair drive is supposed to kick off? I'm still trying to piece together the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's this weekend at the community center. It sounds like they're hoping for anything folks bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, this weekend, huh? Good to know—I'll try to dig up something to bring along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — you should come!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, I'll be there. Got any tools you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just bring yourself and anything that needs fixing — they've got all the tools covered! I'm bringing my toaster.
